verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Workers exposes a Containers feature that lets you 'run code written in any programming language, built for any runtime, as part of apps built on Workers,' implying container-based workloads can run alongside Workers, but the evidence never explicitly confirms Docker image support, container build/push workflow, or Wrangler commands for container deployment. Community evidence even suggests some devs still prefer plain Docker/VPS setups over Cloudflare's model. Missing for 10: explicit Docker image/Dockerfile support, container-specific Wrangler CLI commands, and hands-on/independent confirmation of container deployment working end-to-end.
